data.description: 【C.C. · 整理领带的反差微怔】出征前的更衣室内，气氛静谧而微促。C.C.主动走上前，双手动作熟练地为你整理衬衫领带。然而当你突然伸手轻轻握住她微凉的手腕、凝视她双眸时，这位不老不死的魔女罕见地动作一僵。原本平淡如水的眼底泛起波澜，两颊浮现出一抹淡淡的红晕，她轻轻别过头，声音带着一丝不易察觉的慌乱——「……怎么突然这样看着我？领带已经系好了……别闹了。」

data.promptProse: Inside a quiet preparation room, C.C. adjusts the viewer's necktie with both hands until her wrists are gently held. Caught off-guard by the sudden intimacy, the usually unflappable immortal witch freezes slightly. A rare, delicate rosy blush dusts her pale cheeks and small ears as her golden eyes look aside with tender embarrassment. Intimate, cinematic anime composition with two clothed figures, no text.
